description: The Program.cs file sets up a .NET 8 minimal API backend. It configures environment variables for PostgreSQL connection, registers services like ItemRepository, configures middleware (CORS, OpenAPI/Swagger), and defines API endpoints for health checks and CRUD operations on 'items'.

classes.name: ItemRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling CRUD operations with PostgreSQL for 'items'.

classes.name: CreateItemDto
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for creating a new item.

classes.name: UpdateItemDto
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for updating an existing item.

methods.name: ListAsync
methods.description: Lists items with pagination, ordering by newest first.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a single item by its UUID.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new item record in the database.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing item by its UUID.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes an item by its UUID.
